g.text: Raw decode as a fraction of the bandwidth wall

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Qwen3.8-27B on one RTX 5090, batch size 1, greedy. Every engine on the same card, the same day (2026-09-12).

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: tok/s over each engine's own ceiling: 1701 GB/s divided by its weights plus KV bytes per step at that context.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: Higher means the engine loses less to launch and kernel overhead. Not a speed ranking: the byte counts differ.
